positions.name: Sprint4DeliveryAccount
positions.frame: how do we account for what Sprint 4 delivered and what enabled it?
positions.why: All three expressions are confident, past-tense, realis claims about Sprint 4 outcomes — the deliverable (widget shipped), the performance metric (23-point velocity, highest this quarter), and the causal explanation (Zephyr integration as key unlock). They cohere as a single account of Sprint 4's delivery: what was shipped, at what velocity, and why that velocity was achievable. Internal tension is appropriate — src-1's communal 'we shipped' pools team effort while src-2's metric-anchored 'highest this quarter' performs a comparative achievement stance, but both are facets of the same delivery account read through the frame of 'what happened and what drove it.'
